evals.prompt:
i need to add a new settings page to our app. its a Next.js 14 app router project using shadcn/ui and Tailwind. we use Zustand for client state and TanStack Query for server state. the page should let users update their profile (name, email, avatar upload) and notification preferences (email notifications on/off, push notifications on/off, digest frequency: daily/weekly/never). needs to work on mobile too.

check the existing code patterns first, our other settings pages are in app/(dashboard)/settings/
evals.expected_output: A settings page component following existing project patterns. Uses shadcn form components, Zustand + TanStack Query as established, TypeScript interfaces for form data, proper loading/error states, responsive layout, accessible form with labels and error handling.
expectations: Reads or references existing settings pages in app/(dashboard)/settings/ to match patterns
Uses App Router conventions (page.tsx, not pages/)
Uses shadcn/ui form components (Input, Switch, Select/RadioGroup, Button, Label)
Uses TanStack Query for fetching and mutating user settings (not raw fetch)
Uses Zustand only if there's client-side state that warrants it — doesn't force it
Form data is typed with a TypeScript interface, not `any`
All form fields have associated labels for accessibility
Handles loading state while fetching current settings
Handles error state if save fails, with an actionable user message
Responsive — works at mobile widths (not just desktop)
Avatar upload handles file type validation

evals.prompt:
I need a data table component for our admin panel. We use Vue 3 with Composition API and our design system uses PrimeVue components. The table needs sorting, pagination, and a search filter. It should display user data: name, email, role (admin/editor/viewer), status (active/suspended), and last login date.

check our project conventions before building this. our CLAUDE.md should have the patterns.
evals.expected_output: A Vue 3 Composition API component using PrimeVue DataTable with sorting, pagination, and search. Follows project conventions. TypeScript interfaces for user data. Loading and empty states handled.
expectations: Uses Vue 3 Composition API (<script setup lang='ts'>), not Options API
Uses PrimeVue DataTable component (not a custom table implementation)
Includes TypeScript interface for the user data shape (name, email, role, status, lastLogin)
Sorting is implemented via PrimeVue's built-in sorting, not custom logic
Pagination is implemented (PrimeVue Paginator or DataTable's built-in)
Search/filter functionality filters across relevant columns
Loading state is handled while data is being fetched
Empty state is handled (no users match filters)
Mentions reading CLAUDE.md or project conventions before building
Role and status columns use appropriate visual indicators (badges, colors) from PrimeVue
Date formatting for lastLogin column is handled properly
